__doc: Per-model quality floors for the finder-recall eval (--set=pr, 8 PRs).
Gate = RUN MEAN vs floor — never per-PR (per-PR recall sd is 0.14-0.23;
individual PRs scoring 0 is normal).
recallFloor  = observed recall_mean − 2·SEM (SEM = cross-PR sd / √8).
minMeanFindings / minMeanToolCalls = ~half the observed per-case mean —
low-noise collapse detectors: they don't move on recall noise, they trip
when the engine breaks (prompt lost, tools dead, findings not parsed).
Calibrated 2026-07-02 from one full --set=pr run per model on the
post-#1424 engine (evals/investigation/results/finder-recall-<model>-pr.json).
RATCHET RULE: when a PR intentionally improves/regresses a model, update
that model's floors in the same PR with a fresh --set=pr run as evidence.
JUDGE (#1447): floors were calibrated under the claude-sonnet-4-6 judge;
the judge is now claude-haiku-4-5. Validated invariant in the agreement
study (evals/investigation/agreement/): per-PR recall mean shifts −0.3pp —
far inside cross-PR noise (SEM ~5-6pp) — so these floors stay valid as-is.
Floors for the NIGHTLY run (code-review-evals-nightly.yml): --set=light, 30 PRs.
Recalibrated 2026-10-17 when every eval moved to production's org route
(evals/shared/model-route.js). Before, the finder ran the self-hosted env route
(applyModelEnv): DeepSeek went with reasoning_effort high, and the model's key
overwrote the platform key, so the dedup's embedder failed. Now it runs the managed
default a cloud org without BYOK gets: no reasoning_effort, and the embedder works.
Two local runs of the nightly command on feat/evals-production-parity 57ef595ce,
deepseek-v4-flash@fireworks, judge gpt-5.6-luna low: recall_mean 0.416 and 0.383
(precision 0.466 and 0.436, loop recall 0.503 and 0.492). Before, on the env route:
0.569 and 0.518. One run with RECALL_REASONING_EFFORT=high (a stored BYOK config):
0.477, +0.078 per PR against these two (paired se 0.033, 10 PRs up, 3 down).
The floor comes from RUN-TO-RUN noise on these 30 PRs, not cross-PR spread: the
per-PR recall difference between the two runs has sd 0.276, so a night's mean
moves 0.276/sqrt(2)/sqrt(30) = 0.036, and against this 2-run baseline
0.036*sqrt(1.5) = 0.044. recallFloor 0.30 = 0.399 - ~2.2 sigma: a ~10pp drop trips
it, a normal night does ~1-2% of the time; a drop is then confirmed on a second run.
minMeanFindings / minMeanToolCalls = ~half the observed mean (2.95 / 41). Tool calls
are the finder trace's (gate.js read a replay-only counter before, 0 on this path).
Deliberate break, local only: the medium severity filter dropping medium findings
gave 0.275 (loop recall 0.465), below the floor. The fast step budget on a normal
review gave 0.43 at 18 tool calls: only minMeanToolCalls catches that one.
JUDGE: floors hold only under `judge` + `judgeReasoningEffort`; the gate refuses a
run judged otherwise. To change the judge, re-judge two calibration runs with
rejudge.js (cents, no finder re-run) and update this block in the same PR.
RATCHET RULE: when a PR intentionally moves recall, re-run --set=light twice
on it and update these floors in the same PR.

The controlled set (recall-tests.js CONTROLLED_CASES, 15 PRs: three per repository of the light set, the three with the most known bugs, 61 of its 95): the nightly, and every tier-0 model's weekly run (evals/weekly.js). Floors per model, each under the judge below; noise as in nightly-compare.js nightNoise: sdPerPrRunDiff / sqrt(2) / sqrt(15), times sqrt(1.5) for a two-run baseline.

deepseek-v4-flash@fireworks, calibrated 2026-10-17 from 2 local runs on a725253d6 (the managed route, judge gpt-5.6-luna low): recall 0.460 and 0.437 (one PR of the second run not measured, rate limit; 14 PRs paired), mean 0.448, sdPerPrRunDiff 0.246, sigma 0.057. recallFloor = mean - 2.2 sigma = 0.32. Collapse floors at about half the observed means: 3.61 findings and 40.5 tool calls per PR.

gpt-6-sol, calibrated 2026-10-17 from 2 local runs on a725253d6 (judge gpt-5.6-luna low): recall 0.494 and 0.484 (15 PRs paired), mean 0.489, sdPerPrRunDiff 0.266, sigma 0.059. recallFloor = mean - 2.2 sigma = 0.35. Collapse floors at about half the observed means: 5.37 findings and 69.7 tool calls per PR.

claude-sonnet-5-5, calibrated 2026-10-17 from 2 local runs on a725253d6 (judge gpt-5.6-luna low): recall 0.348 and 0.428 (15 PRs paired), mean 0.388, sdPerPrRunDiff 0.197, sigma 0.044. recallFloor = mean - 2.2 sigma = 0.29. Collapse floors at about half the observed means: 2.87 findings and 25 tool calls per PR.

Deliberate break, 2026-10-17 (local, deepseek, on the managed route, before the evals moved to BYOK): the severity filter dropping medium findings: 0.389, above the floor (a drop of 0.06; the floor sits 2.2 sigma, 0.13, under the mean). The controlled set is 15 PRs on purpose (cost, decided 2026-10-17): a drop this size shows on the full set, run on demand, not the nightly. The same break on the 30-PR light set gave 0.275, below its floor.

kimi-k2.7-code@openrouter, calibrated 2026-10-17 from 2 local runs on a725253d6 and 8971e8fb3 (judge gpt-5.6-luna low): recall 0.456 and 0.511 (15 PRs paired), mean 0.483, sdPerPrRunDiff 0.189, sigma 0.042. recallFloor = mean - 2.2 sigma = 0.39. Collapse floors at about half the observed means: 4.07 findings and 35.9 tool calls per PR.

deepseek-v4-flash@fireworks, calibrated 2026-10-17 from 2 local runs on 641fb1999 (BYOK route) (judge gpt-5.6-luna low): recall 0.331 and 0.45 (15 PRs paired), mean 0.391, sdPerPrRunDiff 0.181, sigma 0.04. recallFloor = mean - 2.2 sigma = 0.3. Collapse floors at about half the observed means: 3.03 findings and 37.4 tool calls per PR.
RATCHET: a PR that moves recall on purpose recalibrates here, with two runs as evidence.
